messages:
sam: Quick sync idea: tighten postmortem follow-ups so remediations don't drift. Proposal: single owner SLA, 30/60/90 checkpoints, a small Remediations lane, weekly 3-line digest to #incidents, and a remediation-shepherd role. Thoughts?

leila: +1. My main ask: require owner + due_epoch on creation. If unassigned for 48h auto-assign to oncall lead.

omar: Agree. Keep remediations separate from dev tasks. Tag cards with type=remediation and require these fields: owner, due_epoch, severity, recurrence_tag, blocked_by(optional).

jun: For follow-ups, auto-create 30/60/90 checkpoint comments when remediation is filed. Each checkpoint should capture status, last_update_epoch, and who updated. That makes reviews easy.

sam: Automation plan: reminders 7d & 1d before due -> ping owner; shepherd nudge if no update 48h after assignment; weekly Monday 09:00 digest: top overdue, new recurring patterns, closed this week.

sre-bot: Automation draft registered: rem-followups-2026 (reminders + shepherd_nudge + weekly_digest). Opt-in rollout required.

leila: Rotation: IC weekly. Remediation-shepherd = 2-week role; shepherd nudges owners, escalates blockers, and owns weekly digest. Incoming IC shadows outgoing for 48-72h for context.

omar: recurrence_score idea: count(similar_incidents) in last_90d. Flag recurrence_score>1. Add fields first_seen_epoch and last_seen_epoch on card. We'll surface heatmap by service + recurrence_score.

jun: UI: show recurrence badge, blocked_eta free-text, and a small closure_reason enum (fix/deferred/dup). Also allow filter: type=remediation & recurrence_score>1 & open>21d.

sam: Pilot plan: 6 weeks on two services (auth + kv). Backfill existing remediations for pilot, measure: avg_time_open, percent_closed_by_due, recurrence_trend. Volunteers?

leila: I can run the pilot and post weekly status here. Omar will own recurrence queries & alerts, Jun will build lane template and backfill, Sam will draft handbook updates and digest copy.

omar: I'll also add alert: remediation open>21d && recurrence_score>=2 -> post to #incidents and page oncall lead.

jun: sample card template I'll add to the board: ```action: short summary
owner: @user
due_epoch: 1700000000
severity: P1/P2
type: remediation
recurrence_tag: infra|config|process|3rd_party
first_seen_epoch: 1700000100
last_update_epoch: 1700000200
blocked_by: ticket# or none
blocked_eta: text
closure_reason: 
status: open
```

sam: Good. Next steps:
- leila: pilot owner + weekly updates
- jun: board template + backfill by Fri
- omar: recurrence queries + alert by Thu
- sam: update handbook + shepherd policy by next Mon

sre-bot: Created tasks: https://redwood/tasks/7001 (pilot), https://redwood/tasks/7002 (board template), https://redwood/tasks/7003 (recurrence queries)

leila: Thanks all. Goal is to reduce remediation slippage and catch recurring patterns earlier. We'll reconvene in one week. :calendar:
